test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

I __will going__ __on__ __an official tour__ __next week__.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **will going**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"will going"** contains an error because** "will" **should be followed by the base form of the verb, which is **"go."**
 
• The correct form should be **"will go"** instead of **"will going."**
 
• When expressing future plans or intentions, the construction **"will" + base verb** is appropriate.
 
 
• For example: I will go to the party tomorrow.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **will going**.

The corrected sentence should be: *I **will go** on an official tour next week*.
